payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: FATE-M, difficulty: easy).

Informal statement:
For every positive integer n at least two, the ring of integers modulo n is a field if and only if n is prime.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n

Each role chooses its next allowed action. Use search_lemmas and check_lean when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

tool_calls.name: search_lemmas
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"ZMod n is a field if and only if n is prime"}

tool_responses.content:
Top matches (name signature -- description):
ZMod.instField : Field (ZMod p)  -- ZMod p is a Field for Prime p
isReduced_zmod  {n : ℕ} : IsReduced (ZMod n) ↔ Squarefree n ∨ n = 0  -- ZMod n is Reduced if and only if n is Square-Free or Zero
Nat.prime_iff_card_units  (p : ℕ) [Fintype (ZMod p)ˣ] : p.Prime ↔ Fintype.card (ZMod p)ˣ = p - 1  -- Prime iff Unit Group Cardinality is p-1
ZMod.instField.congr_simp  ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], ZMod.instField p = ZMod.instField p  -- Congruence Simplification for Field Structure on ZMod p
ZMod.nontrivial_iff  {n : ℕ} : Nontrivial (ZMod n) ↔ n ≠ 1  -- Non-trivial ℤ/nℤ iff n ≠ 1
